status: Provisional single-coder keyword rule written before it was applied; not validated, no inter-rater check. It is a navigation aid, not a classification of what a claim means.
applies_to: claim wording only; case-insensitive; each term is a regular-expression fragment anchored at a word start (\b + term), so 'replicat' matches 'replication' and 'care\b' matches only the word 'care'
source_of_axis: G01 Research/README.md section 9.4: fourth axis = ethical orientation with five lenses (Truth, Integrity, Love, Justice, Wisdom); 'foreground lenses, not a complete moral theory'.
revision_note: 1.0.1 (before publication, after a 12-claim spot-check): removed the Wisdom term 'practice', which matched 'distributed practice' (a learning-science claim). Other known lexical false positives are kept and documented rather than tuned away.
